name: Dress watch
description: A large gold wristwatch with a silver bezel and dial, worn more to be seen than to tell the time.
notes: Lying face up with the bracelet opened out, 220 mm end to end: a 44 mm gold case, a silver bezel set with gold hour marks, a silver dial with gold hands, a crown on +x and three-piece gold links with silver centres to a fold clasp. Telling the time is pending in Deadvox, so it declares no tool quality, as the gold watch. Slot `wrist` as the other watches. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Cannon-case necklace
description: A big spent brass cannon case hung on a plain cotton cord. Heavy on the chest and hard to miss.
notes: A cotton cord laid in a ring 130 mm across, knotted at the back, wound at the front round the groove of a spent 25 mm case 80 mm long lying mouth outward; the brass is left dull. The model lays the cord out round the case. Slot `neck` as the other necklaces. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Pistol-case necklace
description: A spent pistol case strung on a plain cotton cord.
notes: The same cord as the cannon-case necklace with a spent 9 mm pistol case 19 mm long. The model lays the cord out round the case. Slot `neck` as the other necklaces. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Rifle-case necklace
description: A spent bottlenecked rifle case strung on a plain cotton cord.
notes: The same cord as the cannon-case necklace with a spent bottlenecked rifle case 51 mm long. The model lays the cord out round the case. Slot `neck` as the other necklaces. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Small relic
description: A small silver case lined in red velvet, holding a sliver of bone from someone once thought holy.
notes: Lying open, 80 mm long: an oval silver case 36 mm by 28 mm lined in `velvet-red` with a bone sliver bedded in it, its lid hinged open at -z with a raised cross, and a ring at +z for a cord. The draft carries no `wearable` and it is a carried keepsake.

name: Bunny tail
description: A round white pom-pom costume tail with a clip on the back.
notes: An 80 mm pom-pom of soft balls round a core, sitting on its flat back with a black clip under it; `fur-pale` stands in for faux fur. The model keeps a costume tail's size. It clips onto a belt or waistband, so it fits `belt` and takes no body slot, as the other costume tails. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Tie clip
description: A polished silver bar that clips a necktie to the shirt front.
notes: Lying flat, 55 mm long: a silver front bar with two engraved lines near one end, folded back at +x into a spring blade beneath. Slot `collar`, shared with collar bars: no slot names a tie, so tie and collar hardware share one slot until a necktie exists. A collar bar and tie clip worn together would need a separate `tie` slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wooden hair beads
description: A handful of round wooden beads with wide holes, for threading onto braids or locs.
notes: A loose heap 55 mm across of fourteen beads 8 to 12 mm thick in birch and walnut, standing on end so their holes show from above. The heap spans a box the beads mostly leave empty. Slot `hair` as the other hair beads. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Woven anklet
description: A band of bright cord woven in a repeating chevron pattern, tied round the ankle.
notes: Lying flat, 80 mm across: a 6 mm band in red, yellow, green and blue segments with yellow chevrons every fourth segment, its knot and tie ends trailing at -z. Slot `anklet`, apart from `ankle` which ankle pouches take. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Digital watch
description: A cheap digital wristwatch on a black resin strap, with a stopwatch and an alarm.
notes: Lying face up with the strap opened out, 230 mm end to end: an octagonal black case 38 mm across with a steel face plate, a green display, four steel side buttons, and a resin strap with a steel buckle at -z and holes along +z. Quality `timekeeping` as the diver's watch, for its time and alarm. Slot `wrist` as the other watches. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
